architecture: static modular source with shared world integration foundations, centralized language, explicit service boundaries, and regression diagnostics
notes: No Node, npm, bundler, or build command is required for deployment.
The standalone remains the primary self-contained test artifact.
Player-facing language is centralized; persistence keys are protected engine constants.
High-risk combat, companion and navigation crossings route through SOSServices.
REGRESSION_AUDIT.md records long-running-save compatibility validation.
